notes.title: DreamAbyss: survivors Playing
notes.content: [p][b]DreamAbyss: Survivors[/b] is a roguelike survival action game where you fight to stay alive in a world where dreams and nightmares collide. Face relentless waves of nightmare creatures, master various weapon and skill combinations, and uncover the mysteries hidden within the abyss. Every run is different—adapt, survive, and grow stronger with each attempt.[/p]

notes.title: DreamAbyss: Survivors Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601968/425debd62a7d6b5c357633f292de651b1d0d2c23.png"][/img]Hello, everyone! This is Studio215.
The demo version of [b]DreamAbyss: Survivors[/b], the nightmare survival game starring Lily, is now available![/p][p][/p][p]In this demo, you can experience the following content:[/p][list][*][p][b]2 out of 6 stages[/b] are available to play[/p][/*][*][p][b]2 difficulty levels (Normal, Nightmare)[/b] out of 3 (Normal, Nightmare, Hell)[/p][/*][*][p][b]5 languages[/b] out of 10 are currently supported
[i](Please note: translations are temporary and will be improved in the future)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]3 out of 4 playable characters[/b], including:[/p][list][*][p][b]Our main heroine, Lily[/b] [/p][/*][*][p][b]Arthea, the Child of the Forest[/b] [/p][/*][*][p][b]Camilla, Mistress of the Ruins[/b] [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]9 out of 12 exclusive weapons[/b][/p][list][*][p]Each character can choose from 3 unique weapons[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]18 out of 24 exclusive skills[/b][/p][list][*][p]Each weapon comes with 2 dedicated skills[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]17 common skills[/b] are available right away[/p][list][*][p]Including unlockable Tier 2 and Tier 3 skills[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]We’re carefully reviewing all player feedback to make the official release even better.
We plan to continue communicating actively with you and provide exciting new content!
A detailed roadmap will be shared soon.[/p]
